# STAR

`nf-core/star`

An aligner that maps sequencing reads to a large reference genome, such as the human genome. Here it builds the genome index and aligns RNA-seq reads to it.

Homepage: https://github.com/alexdobin/STAR

Cite: doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/bts635
